decision: Limit suggestion colour and underline to the untyped suffix of the existing preedit payload.
reason: The user reports the whole current word styled as IME in Firefox. The installed source serializes gray and single underline over every scalar in both suffix-only and full owned compositions. Source/client text acceptance never certified pixels or prefix decoration.
verification: Planned: exact serialized prefix/suffix attributes, production publication with native and owned buffers, Unicode scalars, no candidate, mid-word caret and replacement; controlled old-boundary failure; original nonzero IME closure, unchanged style gates, architecture graph/canon and one IME build; physical owned Firefox and Chrome fields with pixels plus Backspace/retype/Tab.
not_tested: The new boundary is not implemented or installed at recording time. No changed-byte physical acceptance, Firefox default-decoration suppression, all-window or complete release PASS.

consequences.candidates_rank_authority: No candidate generation, retention, ranking, target, acceptance lease or verifier change. Colour is a rendering property and never grants Tab or mutation authority.
consequences.boundary: A payload with an exact current composition-buffer prefix marks only its remaining suffix. Empty owned buffer means native suffix-only display. Nonmatching replacement payload is neutral. Typed prefix receives explicit IBus Underline.NONE to suppress client defaults. The caret is not the suffix boundary; a mid-word caret must not style typed trailing characters as prediction.
consequences.latency_cpu_memory: One bounded existing string-prefix comparison and scalar count per publication; at most one additional fixed-size wire attribute. No worker, corpus scan, timer, cache, queue or persistent allocation.
consequences.identity_packages_learning: Existing generation, context reset, cache invalidation, package/delta reload and learning/feedback identities remain unchanged. Future candidate packages use the same exact prefix boundary; mismatching surfaces remain neutral rather than acquire false suggestion decoration.
consequences.concurrency: Decoration derives synchronously from the same engine state and payload. Retained display remains inert under the existing freshness checks. No new callbacks, stale-result admission or ownership transfer.
consequences.compatibility: Keep full owned and native suffix-only payloads, cursor, signal order and all transport protocols. Legacy clients consume the new attribute ranges; atomic transport currently extracts plain text and remains unchanged. Actual Firefox rendering needs physical evidence because wire attributes alone cannot prove pixels.
consequences.failure_rollback: Retain exact installed IME rollback and other daemon/model/config/global-IBus identities. Only root may reload the existing IME channel after source gates and independent review. If Firefox ignores neutral prefix attributes, reanalyse the rendering boundary; never convert owned text into a second editor to obtain a screenshot PASS.
consequences.maintenance: Extend the existing serializer and publisher; no new owner, detector, executor, mode initiator, fallback or alternate source of truth. Preserve native suffix formatting and add a production publisher assertion so full-word decoration cannot be certified by DOM-only acceptance again.
